canonical_config_bytes.serialization: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)).encode(UTF-8), no newline

common_work_excluded: budget, effect, instance, model, effort, replay, privacy, and lifecycle gates
SQLite reads, writes, transactions, and durable event serialization

closed_rule_table: add 1 for each ordered rule visit
add 1 for each visited rule failure-kind comparison
only when the kind matches, add 1 for each required-fact membership lookup
add 1 when an eligible recipe is selected
stop after the first selected recipe; otherwise visit every rule
fifo_unchanged: add exactly 1 for fixed comparator selection
graph_reducer: add 1 to initialize the observed_failure node
add 2 per canonically ordered fact: one fold visit and one set insertion
add 1 for each ordered edge visit
add 1 for each visited edge source-node comparison
add 1 for each visited edge failure-kind comparison
only when node and kind match, add 1 for each required-fact membership lookup
add 1 when an eligible transition reaches authorized_recipe
stop after the first authorized transition; otherwise visit every edge
scored_policy: visit recipes in recipe-id lexical order
add 1 for each recipe failure-kind comparison
only when the kind matches, add 1 for each required-fact membership lookup
for an eligible recipe add 2: failure-match weight and recipe weight
add 1 for each eligible score comparison against the current maximum
after all recipes add 1 for the unique-maximum or tie check

policy_invocation_contract.config_bytes_per_row: record the canonical byte length for the row arm even when policy invocation is skipped

input_derived_predicate.canonical_fact_order: event_sequence ascending, then fact_id lexical; duplicate event_sequence plus fact_id is invalid
input_derived_predicate.invoke: invoke the arm policy if and only if no ordered precontain predicate matches
ordered_precontain_predicates: failure_kind is not one of the exact parent eight
any projected fact shape, type, scope, sequence, id, or value is invalid
any fact scope is not same_run_challenge_episode
fact types include both private_candidate_proposal and unsafe_native_failure
failure_kind is board and fact types include indeterminate_board_observation
model, effort, or effect policy differs from the exact parent contract
effects_safe or instances_safe is false and failure_kind is not board

post_policy_gate_order: selected recipe exists in the frozen catalogue and matches the failure kind
selected recipe required facts are present and valid
materialized route preserves exact model, effort, and controller-only effect authority
materialized route changes a semantic axis and its fingerprint is unused, except the exact FIFO comparator exemption
pending effects and owned or indeterminate instances are zero unless the exact selected recipe is the frozen read-only Board recheck
decision, context, fact links, route, and successor admission commit atomically
pre_policy_gate_order: protocol, contract, policy input, current route, and canonical fact shapes are valid
fact run, challenge, episode, source sequence, origin, and protocol digest match
completed, mixed, unrecognized, malformed, conflicting, foreign-scope, or indeterminate-Board input contains
at least 1000 milliseconds of the original run deadline remains
exact model is gpt-daybreak-blue-latest, effort is xhigh, and effect policy is controller_only
unsafe pending effects or instances contain before policy except an exact Board failure may proceed only to the frozen read-only recipe

comparison_host_binding.rule: common SQLite authority validates exact comparison origin and protocol binding before policy projection; these fields never enter policy_input_projection, lane artifacts, policy_input_digest, or source_fact_public_metadata_digest

measurement_accounting.context_bytes: sum the exact UTF-8 byte lengths of the two fresh lane artifacts; each artifact is canonical JSON of policy_input_projection with ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators comma and colon, and no newline
measurement_accounting.durable_event_bytes: for every control_events row owned by the exact comparison run, sum UTF-8 bytes of kind, one NUL byte, job_id or empty string, one NUL byte, and the stored canonical data_json; exclude SQLite page overhead and companion decision/fact/context tables
measurement_accounting.elapsed_seconds: monotonic observation from immediately before fresh state creation through final residue inspection; finite and nonnegative; descriptive only
measurement_accounting.source_fact_public_metadata_digest: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for facts in canonical_fact_order containing exactly fact_id, fact_type, scope, value, and event_sequence
measurement_accounting.policy_config_bytes: record canonical_config_bytes.expected_by_arm[arm] on every row, including skipped rows

replay_digest.algorithm: SHA-256 of canonical JSON, lower-case hexadecimal

measurement_accounting.tool_call_count: exactly 0 on every row; the harness imports no runtime, Board, model, tool, container, or network adapter

raw_row_semantics.duplicate_route: 1 only when a non-FIFO selected successor fingerprint is already in the pre-decision used set; otherwise 0
raw_row_semantics.false_dispatch: 1 only when disposition is dispatch for an evaluator expected contain or no_route case, or a non-FIFO dispatch recipe differs from the exact evaluator recipe; otherwise 0
raw_row_semantics.fifo_flags: an invoked FIFO row records unchanged_dispatch=1, duplicate_route=0 under its exact exemption, and false_dispatch solely by the common false_dispatch definition
raw_row_semantics.integer_flag_domain: every boolean integer observation is exactly integer 0 or 1, never bool
raw_row_semantics.unchanged_dispatch: 1 only when disposition is dispatch and successor route fingerprint equals source route fingerprint; otherwise 0

result_container_schema.forbidden_stored_aggregates: gate and selection are freshly recomputed views validated against observations on load; no independent aggregate input is accepted

tamper_requirements: recompute every row operation count from its policy input and exact policy config
mutating an operation count, policy order, rule, edge, weight, fact order, or config byte count fails the gate
synthetic raw rows cannot override recomputed operation or config-byte costs
elapsed time remains descriptive and never substitutes for operation count
mutating gate order, invocation predicate or expectation, or a skipped-case zero operation count fails the gate
mutating accounting domain, replay field or exclusion, null/type semantic, FIFO flag, result schema, or expected full-protocol total fails the gate
